name: Cloudflare R2
description: S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees, accessed through presigned URLs.

pricing.notes: Free allowance: 10GB storage, 1M Class A + 10M Class B operations/month. Beyond that it's pure pay-per-use ($0.015/GB-month storage) with no egress fees and no flat subscription tier. Checked 2026-08-07.
